title: Proctor Silex Sound Shield Electric Coffee Grinder for Quiet Grinding, Stainless Steel Blades, Beans, Spices and More, 12 Cups, Black (80402)
features: 50% QUIETER* WHEN GRINDING COFFEE — This electric coffee grinder is designed with Sound Shield technology to be 50% quieter.* Grind coffee without waking the family and savor your peaceful mornings or some "me" time anytime of day.

GRINDS ENOUGH COFFEE TO BREW UP TO 12 CUPS: If you love the delicious taste of coffee made from freshly ground coffee beans, this coffee grinder is perfect for you. Make a quick cup or a full pot. It grinds enough to make up to 12 cups of coffee.

EASY POURING AND CLEANUP: The grinding bowl on the coffee bean grinder electric is easy to remove to fill with coffee beans or to pour ground coffee after grinding. The bowl is dishwasher safe for easy cleanup.
POWERFUL PERFORMANCE AND PROVEN DURABILITY: The grinding blades on this small coffee grinder are made of durable stainless steel to grind coffee for brewing cup after delicious cup for years to come.
SIMPLE AND INTUITIVE: The coffee grinder electric is simple to use. Just press down on the outer lid to grind coffee and release to stop grinding.
*Compared to other blade coffee grinders from Hamilton Beach Brands.
